newsitem.title: CANADA: Veritas DGC files US$75 mln notes offering.
newsitem.headline: Veritas DGC files US$75 mln notes offering.

text.p: Veritas DGC Inc said on Monday it filed a registration statement with the Securities and Exchange Commission for a proposed public offering of US$75.0 million principal amount of senior notes due 2003.

Veritas, which merged in May with Digicon Inc, said proceeds would be used to fund capital expenditures and to retire outstanding debt, most of which was incurred for capital spending in the past fiscal year.
In the current year, Veritas said it embarked on a capital budget in excess of US$60.0 million designed to increase the efficiency of its principal products and services.
